summary: 6 film announcements, 8 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Untitled Ari Aster Film
film.talent: Jacob Elordi circling role, Scarlett Johansson starring
film.announcement: Jacob Elordi is in negotiations to join Scarlett Johansson in Ari Aster's next film at A24.

film.title: Stag Dance
film.talent: Based on novella by Torrey Peters
film.announcement: Run-A-Muck is developing Torrey Peters' novella 'Stag Dance' for film, which was part of the 2026 Pulitzer Prize finalist collection.

film.title: Nice Eggs
film.talent: Jane Krakowski, Angourie Rice starring; Director Amanda Lipitz
film.announcement: Coming-of-age drama 'Nice Eggs' stars Jane Krakowski and Angourie Rice, directed by Amanda Lipitz.

film.title: Touch Grass
film.talent: Dave Clark directing; Brad Miska and Chris White producing
film.announcement: Promise AI is developing horror feature 'Touch Grass' with Dave Clark directing and Brad Miska and 'Backrooms' EP Chris White producing.

film.title: Ink
film.talent: Guy Pearce as Rupert Murdoch; Director Danny Boyle
film.announcement: Netflix sets U.S. release date for Danny Boyle's tabloid drama 'Ink' starring Guy Pearce as Rupert Murdoch for December theatrical release.

film.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
film.announcement: Samuel Goldwyn acquires North America rights to WestEnd Films' holiday comedy 'Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint'.

tv.title: St. Denis Medical
tv.talent: Damon Wayans guest starring in Season 3 premiere; David Alan Grier
tv.announcement: Damon Wayans guest stars in the Season 3 premiere of NBC's 'St. Denis Medical' in an 'In Living Color' reunion with David Alan Grier.

tv.title: Line of Fire
tv.announcement: Josh Safran and Peter Krause tease new NBC series 'Line of Fire'.

tv.title: Monsterverse Series
tv.talent: Wyatt Russell leading; Connie Nielsen and Stana Katic cast
tv.announcement: Connie Nielsen and Stana Katic join the Wyatt Russell-led Monsterverse series for Apple TV+.

tv.title: Dig
tv.talent: Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie starring; created by Mike Schur and J.J. Philbin
tv.announcement: Peacock sets premiere date for comedy series 'Dig' starring Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie, with first-look photos released.

tv.title: Ascension
tv.talent: Caitríona Balfe starring; created by Alfonso Cuarón
tv.announcement: Apple TV+ orders Alfonso Cuarón's cult horror thriller series 'Ascension' with Caitríona Balfe starring.

tv.title: The Sticks
tv.talent: Michelle Monaghan, Scott Bakula, and Logan Marshall-Green; YA hockey drama
tv.announcement: Netflix's YA hockey drama 'The Sticks' starring Michelle Monaghan gets cast additions including Scott Bakula and Logan Marshall-Green confirmed.

tv.title: Ted Lasso
tv.talent: Tanya Reynolds joining Season 4 as a women's soccer coach
tv.announcement: Tanya Reynolds joins 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 as a tough and cold women's soccer coach.

tv.title: Heated Rivalry
tv.announcement: Justice Smith cast in 'Heated Rivalry' project as Harris Drover.
